headline: Frontline Bases Shift as Casualties Surge
war_summary: Three hours after the last dispatch the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has sharpened across the contested hexes. Weathered Expanse now records fifty‑seven ownership changes in the past day, with both Colonial and Warden casualties climbing past one thousand per hour and enlistments accelerating sharply. Nevish Line follows with forty‑three flips and casualty rates exceeding twelve hundred per hour for each side, also accelerating. Linn Mercy logs thirty‑four exchanges, its losses surging after an earlier lull, while Mooring County shows twenty‑three flips and rising casualties. Marban Hollow maintains a high turnover near sixteen events with Warden casualties accelerating, and Stonecradle adds fourteen flips with modestly accelerating enlistments. Meanwhile Callahans Passage and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily without any base movement, and the majority of rear‑area hexes remain static. Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand each see only a handful of changes. The overall picture is one of intensifying frontline combat concentrated in a handful of sectors, while the broader map holds its breath.
